name: Invictus International School
summary: Multi-campus Cambridge pathway often shortlisted as a mid-fee bridge while AEIS outcomes or premium waitlists resolve.
body: Invictus operates multiple Singapore campuses with Cambridge-oriented programmes and a value positioning versus legacy SAS / TTS / UWC-tier fees. Reddit primary-admission and budget threads frequently name Invictus when families need a nearer-term seat than premium waitlists allow, or a bridge year while AEIS / S-AEIS runs. Tour the specific campus your child would attend — culture, facilities, and secondary continuity vary by site. Ask about current fee bands, sibling discounts, and whether your pass type is accepted. Treat it as a campus decision, not a network brand assumption: a Centrium experience is not automatically an East Coast experience. Keep AEIS backup maths honest — mid-fee international is still a material household cost versus MOE international-student fees.
waitlistNotes: Campus-level availability changes term to term — ask which campus has seats for your child’s year group.
